next_diagnostic.execution_slice: Original author start=n_obs_steps-1=1, end=9; align labels to same indices

secondary_readouts.purpose: Separate supervised denoising from free reverse-chain behavior; cannot substitute for generation

output_requirements: Per-window/per-seed predictions and expert targets, valid/padding and executed-slice metadata
Per-role/per-episode action metrics and same-window native-project differences
Representative original-context replay using existing saved reference where available, no repeated full qualification

engineering_budget.execution: Serial endpoint loading, reuse fixed CLIP worker/cache; no new cache of trainable modules
engineering_budget.if_limit_or_memory_failure: Mark incomplete and preserve partial artifacts; do not interpret timeout as a model failure or automatically extend/retry

interpretation.project_poor_on_train: Prioritize conditional action learning/optimization/front-end usability, not merely unseen-data overfitting
interpretation.project_good_on_train_but_unseen_gap: Prioritize representation reliance and distribution coverage/generalization
interpretation.both_similar_on_expert_windows_but_rollo: Prioritize evidence about off-expert inputs and accumulated closed-loop errors; offline similarity alone cannot establish equivalence
interpretation.multimodality: A different action trajectory may also succeed; expert-coordinate error is diagnostic, not a task success metric
interpretation.short_check: Not a new policy improvement verdict; no threshold relaxed or formal run automatically triggered

exclusions: No schedule/normalization/cache consistency reruns without a changed path
No new backbone, no CLIP unfreezing
